categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two segments: Chemicals and Oil Products. The Chemicals segment involves manufacturing and trading of normal paraffins, linear alkylbenzene, linear alkylbenzene sulfonate, fatty alcohol polyoxyethylene ethers, and related surfactants. The Oil Products segment includes storage, terminal operations, blending, customs clearance, and free trade zone operations at Taichung Port, focusing on petroleum product warehousing and logistics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced chemical processing technologies including hydrogenation, alkylation, sulfonation, and distillation for producing paraffins, alkylbenzene, and surfactants. It has implemented energy-saving and emission reduction measures such as furnace and process improvements, ISO 9001 quality management, ISO 14001 environmental management, and ISO 45001 occupational health and safety systems. The company also integrates smart electric metering and energy management systems to enhance operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include international daily chemical brands and detergent manufacturers such as P&G and Unilever, primarily in the cleaning products industry. The company serves industrial sectors requiring solvents and specialty chemicals, as well as petroleum traders and oil companies utilizing its storage and terminal services. Major markets are Taiwan, Mainland China, Southeast Asia, and other international regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan with manufacturing and storage facilities, especially at Taichung Port and Kaohsiung. The company has significant investments and production bases in Mainland China, including Jiangsu, Anhui, Sichuan, Guangdong, and Tianjin regions. It also has overseas subsidiaries and investment holdings in the British Virgin Islands, Hong Kong, the Philippines, and Samoa, supporting international trade and investment.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the chemical and petroleum supply chains. It produces key chemical intermediates (e.g., normal paraffins, alkylbenzene) used by downstream detergent manufacturers and provides storage, blending, and logistics services for petroleum products. It has vertically integrated operations covering upstream raw material procurement, chemical processing, and downstream product distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing product added value through advanced technology integration and R&D acceleration, especially in surfactants and green energy applications. The company focuses on vertical integration along the chemical supply chain, capacity expansion, and international market development. It emphasizes sustainability with initiatives in carbon reduction, energy efficiency, and compliance with environmental regulations, alongside talent development and digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of chemical intermediates and surfactants, as well as service fees from petroleum product storage, terminal operations, and logistics. The company also earns income from trading activities and investments in subsidiaries. It maintains long-term supply contracts and strategic partnerships to stabilize revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of Asia's largest producers of cleaning agent raw materials, holding a significant market position in the normal paraffin and alkylbenzene sectors. It competes with other chemical manufacturers expanding capacity in China and globally. In the oil storage and terminal business, it faces competition from domestic and international operators but leverages geographic advantages and integrated services to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$20.6 billion in the latest fiscal year, with a slight growth of 1.61% over the prior year. Net profit declined by about 30.65% due to increased tax expenses and provisions. Total assets exceeded NT$23.5 billion with equity around NT$16.9 billion, showing steady growth and solid financial structure. The company maintains stable cash flows and plans capital expenditures for capacity expansion and operational improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product quality, operational efficiency, and sustainability as key differentiators. It offers a vertically integrated supply chain ensuring stable raw material supply and cost control. Its chemical products are certified and recognized by international consumer goods companies, supporting premium market positioning. The oil storage segment provides flexible, customer-oriented services with strategic location advantages near major consumption markets and China, enhancing logistics efficiency and customer satisfaction.
